items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I wonder why Sam recorded those hymns. Sam Lawley. [INTERVIEWEE] Well that's fun. That's what the company wanted.

ctx.x: I was a guy. But anytime you buy a piano carpet, piano school or carpet in there, and if you like it, she'd play it for you. She'd play it for you.
I wonder why Sam recorded those hymns. Sam Lawley.
Well that's fun. That's what the company wanted.
